# SEC EDGAR test fixtures

Used by `tests/test_relationships.py`, `tests/test_fundamentals.py` and `tests/test_sec_times.py`, served through `MB_SEC_FIXTURES` (see `scripts/sec.py`).
Real files were downloaded unchanged from sec.gov on 2026-10-05. Hand-made files use fictional
names and CIKs (999xxxx) and copy the structure of real filings. Submission lists
(`data.sec.gov/submissions/CIK*.json`) are generated by the test with dates relative to today.

| File | Provenance |
|---|---|
| `form4_sale.xml` | Real. Form 4, Apple (CIK 320193), accession 0001140361-26-038307: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/320193/000114036126038307/form4.xml |
| `form4_buy.xml` | Hand-made (fictional insiders CIK 9999001/9999002): joint filing, one P purchase, one M exercise, one holdings-only line. |
| `schedule13g.xml` | Real. Schedule 13G, Vanguard Capital Management on Apple, accession 0002100119-26-000139: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/320193/000210011926000139/primary_doc.xml |
| `schedule13d.xml` | Hand-made (fictional activist CIK 9999100): original Schedule 13D on Apple with an item 4 purpose. |
| `schedule13d_other_issuer.xml` | Real. Schedule 13D/A by JPMorgan Chase (CIK 19617) on BlackRock MuniHoldings Fund (issuer CIK 1034665), accession 0001193125-26-410213: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/19617/000119312526410213/primary_doc.xml. The test serves it under Apple's folder URL (synthetic) to check that filings naming another issuer are dropped. |
| `13f_cover.xml` | Hand-made (fictional EXAMPLE CAPITAL, CIK 9999200): complete 13F HOLDINGS REPORT cover, 4 lines. |
| `13f_cover_combination.xml` | Hand-made: 13F COMBINATION REPORT cover with a matching line count. |
| `13f_cover_partial.xml` | Hand-made: holdings report cover announcing 1507 lines, not confidential. |
| `13f_table_latest.xml` | Hand-made information table (its ALLY line copies Berkshire Hathaway's Q2 2026 13F, accession 0001193125-26-352200). |
| `13f_table_previous.xml` | Hand-made information table for the previous quarter. |
| `13f_index.json` | Hand-made filing folder listing (`index.json`) naming `infotable.xml` and `primary_doc.xml`. |
| `company_tickers.json` | Hand-made subset of https://www.sec.gov/files/company_tickers.json (real CIKs for AAPL, MSFT, NVDA). The fictional 13F filers (CIK 9999200 etc.) exist only in the test's config. |
| `13f_cover_norges.xml` | Real. Norges Bank (CIK 1374170) 13F-HR cover for Q1 2026, accession 0001374170-26-000023 (tableEntryTotal 1507, confidential): https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1374170/000137417026000023/primary_doc.xml |
| `13f_table_norges_placeholder.xml` | Real. The single-line placeholder table (CUSIP 000000000) of the same filing: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1374170/000137417026000023/Q1_2026_0.xml |
| `13f_cover_blackrock.xml` | Real. BlackRock, Inc. (CIK 2012383) 13F-HR cover for Q2 2026, a COMBINATION report, accession 0002012383-26-003238: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/2012383/000201238326003238/primary_doc.xml |
| `13f_notice_pershing.xml` | Real. Pershing Square Capital Management (CIK 1336528) 13F-NT for Q2 2026, reported by Pershing Square Inc., accession 0001172661-26-003777: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1336528/000117266126003777/primary_doc.xml |

XBRL company facts (`tests/test_fundamentals.py`): real `data.sec.gov/api/xbrl/companyfacts/` responses
downloaded on 2026-10-05, trimmed to the tags in `CONCEPTS` (scripts/collect_fundamentals.py),
10-Q/10-K forms and facts ending on or after the date given; values, dates and accession numbers
are unchanged, and each tag keeps only its `label` and `units`. The test removes, or re-dates to
yesterday, the facts of Apple's 10-Q 0000320193-26-000020 to play a new filing; the ticker map and
submission lists it serves are generated in the test (real CIKs and accession numbers).

| File | Provenance |
|---|---|
| `companyfacts_aapl.json` | Real, trimmed. Apple Inc. (CIK 320193), all collected tags, facts ending 2025-06-01 or later (filings 0000320193-25-000073, -25-000079 (10-K), -26-000006, -26-000013, -26-000020): https://data.sec.gov/api/xbrl/companyfacts/CIK0000320193.json |
| `companyfacts_bac.json` | Real, trimmed. Bank of America (CIK 70858), tags Revenues, NetIncomeLoss and EarningsPerShareDiluted, facts ending 2025-01-01 or later; holds the restatement of 2025 quarters in the 2026 10-Qs (e.g. Q2 2025 revenue 26,463m in 0000070858-25-000268, 27,443m in 0000070858-26-000394): https://data.sec.gov/api/xbrl/companyfacts/CIK0000070858.json |
| `companyfacts_xom_holdings.json` | Real, trimmed. ExxonMobil Holdings Corp (CIK 2115436, XOM's registrant since Q2 2026), collected tags, facts ending 2025-01-01 or later (10-Q 0000034088-26-000093): https://data.sec.gov/api/xbrl/companyfacts/CIK0002115436.json |
| `companyfacts_xom_34088.json` | Real, trimmed. Exxon Mobil Corporation (CIK 34088, the predecessor registrant), collected tags, facts ending 2025-04-01 or later: https://data.sec.gov/api/xbrl/companyfacts/CIK0000034088.json |

Acceptance times (`tests/test_sec_times.py`): real files downloaded unchanged from sec.gov on
2026-10-06, while the submissions JSON of JPMorgan (19617) and Apple (320193) was served with
every `acceptanceDateTime` shifted later by the New York UTC offset and Tesla's (1318605) was right.

| File | Provenance |
|---|---|
| `hdr_<ticker>_<form>_<accession>.sgml` (9 files) | Real. SGML headers `https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/<cik>/<accession without dashes>/<accession>.hdr.sgml` of every filing in the three trimmed lists below; `<ACCEPTANCE-DATETIME>` is US Eastern and equals the filing index page's "Accepted". |
| `submissions_jpm_trimmed.json`, `submissions_aapl_trimmed.json`, `submissions_tsla_trimmed.json` | Real, trimmed. `https://data.sec.gov/submissions/CIK<10-digit cik>.json` as served on 2026-10-06, `filings.recent` cut to three filings (columns accessionNumber, filingDate, reportDate, acceptanceDateTime, form, items, primaryDocument, primaryDocDescription; values unchanged). JPM: 10-Q 0001628280-26-054343, 8-K 0001628280-26-048078, 10-K 0001628280-26-008131 (shifted, +4h/+4h/+5h). AAPL: Form 4 0001140361-26-038674, 10-Qs 0000320193-26-000020 and 0000320193-25-000008 (shifted). TSLA: 8-Ks 0001628280-26-064366 and 0001628280-26-063820, Form 4 0001104659-26-106432 (right). |
